enrichment.headline: Extends the Escape Technology contract one year, up to $1,277,826.55, without competitive bidding
enrichment.summary: The board finds the district can extend its existing Escape Technology, Inc. contract for one year (July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023) without running a competitive bid. It also approves Addendum No. 5 with the Alameda County Office of Education for up to $1,277,826.55.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Determining and Declaring OUSD Can Enter Into One-Year Extension of the Escape Technology, Inc. Agreement Without Competitive Bidding and Approving Addendum No. 5, Agreement With Alameda County Office of Education

enrichment.headline: Pays up to $75,846.87 for 2022-23 blanket accident insurance covering all enrolled students
enrichment.summary: The board approves the application and payment for the district's Blanket Student Accident Insurance for fiscal year 2022-2023. The policy is underwritten by ACE American Insurance Company, and payment goes to the broker, Myers-Stevens & Toohey & Company, Inc. It covers all enrolled students for injuries on campus, at school-sponsored activities and on direct trips to and from school, up to $75,846.87.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Blanket Student Accident Insurance - Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2022-2023 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Pays up to $54,001.48 for 2022-23 catastrophic accident insurance for students and volunteers
enrichment.summary: The board approves the 2022-2023 coverage request and payment for catastrophic accident insurance for students and volunteers, underwritten by ACE American Insurance Company and paid through the broker Myers-Stevens & Toohey & Company, Inc. It has two parts: one for interscholastic athletics and one for other school activities. Total cost is capped at $54,001.48.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Catastrophic Accident Insurance for Students and Volunteers – Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2021-2022 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Pays $3.5M for excess property and liability coverage and $967,000 for excess workers' comp coverage
enrichment.summary: The board approves 2022-23 membership payments for two kinds of excess insurance. The larger is $3,502,288.00 for excess property and liability coverage through Northern California ReLiEF JPA (a joint powers authority, meaning a public agency pool), with Keenan & Associates as broker. The other is $967,000.00 for excess workers' compensation coverage through Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management (PRISIM), with Alliant Insurance Services, Inc. as broker.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Worker's Compensation Coverage and Excess Property and Liability Coverage - Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2022-2023 - Risk Management Department
